text: The September 2023 Khương Hạ apartment fire killed 56 people. Hanoi police traced ignition to an electrical short in a gasoline scooter on the ground floor.

sources.label: Vietnam Government Portal, Khương Hạ apartment fire investigation

text: During the COVID-19 response, Ho Chi Minh City fire police included medical oxygen storage, supply systems and cylinders in fire-safety inspections of treatment facilities.

sources.label: Ho Chi Minh City Police, fire safety at COVID-19 treatment facilities

text: The CDC identified 38 deaths in 37 fires associated with smoking during long-term oxygen therapy from 2000 to 2007 across Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Oklahoma.

sources.label: CDC MMWR, Fatal Fires Associated with Smoking During Long-Term Oxygen Therapy
